desc: Read input and parse N, A, B, K, and the queries.
Coordinate compress all values in A and B.
Group queries by Y_k to process them offline.
Implement a Fenwick Tree (BIT) that supports point updates and prefix sum queries for both counts and sums.
Iterate Y from 1 to N, adding B[Y] to the BIT.
For each query (X_k, Y_k) when Y reaches Y_k, compute the answer by iterating i from 1 to X_k, querying the BIT for A[i], and summing the results.
Print the answers for each query in the original order.
